title: Burn in an overlay by re-encoding only the spatial blocks it changes

definition.title: Burn in an overlay by re-encoding only the spatial blocks it changes
definition.source_excerpt: Begin with fixed-quantization MJPEG and block-aligned requested overlays; retain untouched coefficients and recompute affected blocks. Verify outside-region pixels and chroma boundaries, including whole-image entropy serialization cost.
definition.impact_basis: Useful stage/operation improvement if the target workload and repeated use exist. Scope comes from the cited card; exposure and effect size are unmeasured.
